legacyPersist.derivation_note: Appended by mkMicrovmConfig; storage helpers can explicitly supply the same persist layout.

dependencies.detail: Local PostgreSQL plus 1 TiB-declared library/state image; no external media virtiofs share.
Pocket ID sole interactive login, restricted client group, stable subject linking and private client secret.
Local ML disabled; Blizzard host proxy on port 3003 relays requests to Kaizer over Tailscale.
Managed immich-web publication and direct LAN TCP 11070 host forward.

gates: Pin compatible server/database components; prove library/database-consistent independent restore, ownership and capacity.
Preserve Pocket ID issuer/client/subject identity and restricted admission; validate browser/mobile authentication privately.
Validate existing remote ML relay through narrow private access.
Prove upload/download/derived assets without duplicate production writes before route/data cutover.
Fresh preview disks only; do not copy/mount/adopt/mutate production application state as groundwork.
Host registry disabled, Flux storage/app layers suspended and VM halted until separate reviewed rollout.
Implement guest image/provisioning, private credentials and narrow network/storage policies before claiming runtime readiness.
Real CDI import, KubeVirt launch, Flux reconciliation, persistence and Git stop/start/update rollback require separately authorized live acceptance.
Assess activation against actual running generation and preserve production MicroVM rollback. No merge/activation/restart/reboot/apply authorized by this inventory.
Off-host backup implementation is deferred; revisit independent backup/restore before production-state migration or MicroVM retirement.

storageNotes: All proposed state PVCs are fresh and blank; source images/mounts are provenance only.
Legacy /persist identity/credentials are not copied; the fresh retained root holds new guest OS state until a per-service identity design is approved.
External media/NFS/virtiofs paths are not mounted by groundwork.
Sizes mirror declared budgets, not observed usage. Review free space, filesystem overhead and restore needs before resuming storage.
